title: Utawarerumono: Above Tuskur
alt: A tall man in a blue robe and a white horned mask stands on a grass ridge at sunset and holds a closed iron fan. Beside him is a woman in a long pale dress with a white animal ear and a thick white tail. A small girl rides a white tiger ahead of them. A wooden fortress with thatched roofs is in the valley below.
summary: A painting of Hakuowlo, Eruruu, Aruruu and Mukkuru from Utawarerumono in {strokes} brush strokes, with a playback of each stroke.
text: This is the first Utawarerumono, a game by Leaf and Aquaplus. A wounded man with no memory wakes in a village. A white mask is on his face, and it does not come off. Eruruu nurses him, and her grandmother names him Hakuowlo. Later he becomes the emperor of a new country, Tuskur.
He stands above the fortress with Eruruu near sunset. Her sister Aruruu rides ahead on Mukkuru, the white tiger. The painting has {strokes} brush strokes.
